actions.new_text: In 2Cor 5:16 'once regarded' is Paul's former way of knowing and taking account of Christ, by the standard of the flesh, which he says he has put away: a second verb of knowing (G6063) is used for how he now takes account of no one. It names a past habit of judgment, set against the present.
